title: OpenTelemetry events of a session go to a local file and join the transcript by id
goal: A documented setting turns on CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY with a console or file exporter and tool details off, so tool_result and api_request events (duration, sizes, cost, prompt.id, tool_use_id) land in a local file outside the repository; a read-only command joins them to a transcript by tool_use_id and request_id and prints cost per prompt, and no event text reaches the store or the API.

gates.question: Capture Claude Code OpenTelemetry events locally? Its log exporter offers only otlp, console or none (kb public/claude/otel-monitoring.md), so a local file needs a receiver.
options: no: transcripts and hooks are enough (kbusage already gives per-prompt usage); drop the item
a standard-library OTLP http/json receiver in _tools that writes a local file
the console exporter in headless claude -p runs only, read from stderr
gates.recommendation: no: transcripts and hooks are enough (kbusage already gives per-prompt usage); drop the item
gates.answer: a standard-library OTLP http/json receiver in _tools that writes a local file
